spark_open.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile standing upright on two hind legs against a plain off-white background. The anterior head, neck, hind legs and long tail have the appearance of a reddish-brown fox with dense fur, while the torso, chest and paired folded wings have the appearance of an owl with layered brown, tan, grey and white feathers. The head is fox-like with a pointed muzzle, the body is stout and upright, the wings are folded close against the sides of the body, and the tail extends straight back behind the legs. The overall coloration is reddish-brown on the head, outer legs and tail, white on the muzzle, throat and chest, and mottled tan, grey and brown with dark speckling and barring on the back and wings.

meta_spark.description: A single standing chimera shown in right profile with the head, hindquarters, legs and long bushy tail of a red fox combined with the wings and plumage of a barn owl. The head is rusty-red above with white on the lower cheeks, chin and throat, a pointed muzzle with a black nose, and upright pointed ears. The chest and front of the neck are fluffy white to buff with fine dark speckles, while the back of the neck and shoulders are buff with gray mottling. Large folded feathered wings lie along both sides of the torso. The lower body and hind legs are covered in reddish-brown fox fur with darker brown-black on the lower legs and paws. A long thick fox tail, reddish-brown with a white tip, extends back and down behind the legs to the ground.
